IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Thursday 5 November
Winds: Southwesterly 10 to 15 knots turning south to southeasterly below 10 knots in the early afternoon then becoming variable in the late afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 6 November
Winds: North to northwesterly 10 to 15 knots turning westerly in the middle of the day.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers.

Saturday 7 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots tending southwesterly 15 to 25 knots during the morning.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the afternoon.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers.

Sunday 8 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots shifting southeasterly during the afternoon.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy.
IDT12420.synoptic: A high pressure system over the Bight is extending a ridge over Tasmania. A cold front is forecast to move over from the west during the day on Friday, followed by a cold southwesterly wind flow which will persist on Saturday. Another high pressure system moves close to Tasmania on Sunday.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Thursday 5 November
Winds: Southwesterly 15 to 25 knots turning northwesterly during the afternoon and evening. Winds reaching up to 30 knots during the afternoon and evening.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the afternoon.
Swell: Southwesterly 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the morning, then tending west to southwesterly 2 to 2.5 metres by early evening.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 6 November
Winds: Northwesterly 20 to 30 knots tending westerly in the morning then decreasing to 15 to 25 knots in the evening.
Seas: 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: West to southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 3 to 4 metres offshore during the morning.
Weather: Cloudy. 95% chance of showers, with possible small hail in the afternoon and evening.

Saturday 7 November
Winds: Westerly 15 to 20 knots turning southwesterly 15 to 25 knots during the morning.
Seas: 1.5 to 2 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 3 to 4 metres offshore.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers, with possible small hail.
